name: scope-ledger
description: Per-goal scope ledger (.claude/scope-ledger.local.md, converge or harvest mode) plus a per-repository follow-ups backlog and six fail-open hooks: the first source write without a ledger — through Edit/Write or through sed -i / perl -pi / redirects / cp / mv / patch in Bash — is denied once; the first prompt of a session gets a non-blocking reminder; review-entry commands (a Skill call or a typed slash command) inject a mode-aware finding-triage policy (adopt what belongs to this change plus exploitable security findings, sibling defects, MUST rules and boy-scout fixes; defer the rest with severity, reason and destination; deferring is scheduling, not dismissal) and count rounds; a Stop with open in-scope items is blocked once per state; SessionStart replays the ledger and announces open follow-ups. Keeps review-driven work from expanding past the original request without letting real bugs or security findings be skipped.
